parsed.rationale: I disagree with the 'normal' read: V1-V4 show QS complexes (loss of R waves) with about 2 mm of ST elevation and T-wave inversion in V2-V3, which is a pathologic anterior pattern. The numeric STEMI threshold is borderline, so this should be correlated clinically and against prior ECGs.
